excluded_platform: Claude validation remains skipped at user request
transport: Process-local existing-auth lean_eval_http; no global configuration changes
runtime: Durable ignored project .local/production-runtime; not system Temp
baseline: Same task, initial sources, tools and grading; no extra skill
treatment: Frozen candidate as native repository .agents/skills/lean-coding with explicit invocation
skill_location_during_development: candidates/v3/SKILL.md; canonical v2 remains unchanged until qualification

development.purpose: Find concrete rule or grader defects; not efficiency confirmation
development.changes: A demonstrated failure may produce a new version/hash; retain all versions and outcomes

production_contract_holdout.admission: Accurate standalone request; original fails at least one behavioral test, reference passes all nonzero tests before solver runs
production_contract_holdout.qualification: All frozen treatment contract tests pass in all repeats; no skill-induced unsafe boundary behavior in review
production_contract_holdout.failure_handling: Never remove or soften a failed case after outcomes. A revealed case used for a fix becomes regression evidence, not a fresh holdout.

real_maintenance_confirmation.eligible_pool: 127 previously unexecuted qualified public upstream cases; exclude all 50 prior evaluated tasks
real_maintenance_confirmation.allocation: Seed20261025 repository-stratified interleaving;20 formal and20 disjoint replication cases selected before any new real solver result
real_maintenance_confirmation.quality_gate: Treatment observed accepted rate>=baseline in each batch and no task with fewer accepted treatment runs; not a population noninferiority proof
real_maintenance_confirmation.hidden_grading: Unchanged pinned upstream whole-file guard suite and frozen overlay hashes; source paths relocated only

efficiency.primary: All reported input+output tokens, including failed attempts, divided by accepted attempts
efficiency.secondary: All CLI client+independent grade seconds, including failed attempts, divided by accepted attempts
efficiency.time_scope: Includes CLI service waits, tools and local retries; excludes controller queue, copying/setup and external review. Failed grading time retained.
efficiency.criterion: Quality gate AND paired task-cluster bootstrap upper cost ratio<0.90 in both disjoint batches
efficiency.quantile: inverted_cdf; whole tasks with both arms and all3 repeats; no undefined draw deletion
efficiency.missing_usage: Never zero-impute. Actual ratio remains unidentified with any unknown usage. Conservative baseline-only bound may be separately reported under the same draw/quantile, never a fabricated point estimate.
efficiency.sample_size_limit: Fixed20 tasks per batch. Previous pilot informs feasibility, not guaranteed power for this candidate or smaller effects. No enlargement based on new real outcomes.

execution.synthetic_grade_modes_scope: Same frozen public contracts in both Python modes; no -O extension to upstream real projects

release_decision.production_assistant_qualified: Frozen production-contract pass, real-task quality gate, native loading/routing checks, independent patch review and reproducible installation/rollback package
release_decision.efficiency_claim_separate: Stable>=10% only when both held-out batches pass the frozen efficiency criterion; a functionality-qualified release must disclose any unproven efficiency claim
release_decision.scope: Coding assistance inside existing project checks/review; not unattended deployment authorization or universal future correctness
release_decision.publication: Prepare locally. No external publication or global installation during comparison.
